risksAndNotes: AC2 is the sharp constraint: the PR MUST touch only stage3-proof.txt. Do not let any incidental file (editor scratch, .legion during review) appear in the product diff — .legion handoffs are process artifacts committed on the branch and are deleted at end of clean review; the READY diff check must show only stage3-proof.txt as the product change.
The spec permits a review to request one additional appended line to the same file; appending it is in scope on the same PR and needs no re-scope or child issue.
No new surface needs to be built: the GitHub PR and the repository main branch already reach every acceptance criterion.
